company.description: Clear Genetics is a digital health company dedicated to the thoughtful integration of genetics into routine patient care. Clear Genetics partners with health systems, labs and academic institutions to increase patient access to genetic counseling and testing.

productsAndServices.description: A HIPAA-compliant clinical chatbot that facilitates virtual conversations with patients, gathers intake information, provides pre-test education, and delivers genetic test results. It can also schedule appointments with genetic counselors when necessary.
